title: Authentication Login Audit Event Contract
description: Draft event contract for authentication login audit emission, source-backed by historical audit and authentication proof evidence.
aiGuidance: Do not emit or rename this event without updating event semantics, audit semantics, and validators together.
ordering: after authentication decision and before readiness claim
retryPolicy: retry only where duplicate audit events remain idempotent by request identifier
dlqPolicy: failed audit emission is a blocking readiness finding, not silently discarded
retention: retained according to audit-event retention policy once authored
failureSemantics: Missing collected audit evidence fails closed for any proof claim that depends on this event.
